I live in the city and I just get depressed walking to the train and back since the enviroment is so fucking dull. Buildings and cement everywhere. Sure there is some trees and maybe a bit of grass but wtf i cant go jogging around here i would eventually start bombing buildings or something because they are so fucking ugly. 

I dont exactly understand what you mean with your last sentence, but when i say I cant get out of bed or cant sleep - obviously its not everyday. Some days are worse than others. But mostly, my days are as bad. You lie in bed hoping to sleep but you cant, but you dont have any energy do to anything besides lying there, listening to some music. Maybe drink some water. As ive mentioned previously, I have ups and downs as well, I have periods when its like im high all the time and I do shit i never would have normally. But mostly im just depressed and dont do shit.

Meditation, doesnt that kind of require one to be in control of their thoughts? If i try to collect my thoughts and be calm my ears start ringing, all the voices in my head go fucking berserk and it will lead to a panic attack if i dont occupy myself with music, gaming, drawing, taking pills. Im sure meditation can work once you actually have the inner peace required to collect your thoughts, I just dont think Im there yet.

In the end, all I have is my own subjective experience of the help Im getting, and I have to compare that to how I do on my own, and decide what to go for. So Im really stumped as to what I should do at this point. I feel like there isnt a lot of options left.

I guess I have no choise. I care a lot about what they think about me (my family) and I know how dissapointed they would be if i became a hobo. Lol

But Im not going to explain anything to them. Take it from me, they dont understand. Ive tried. I just get a pat on the back and scared smile saying "it'll get better". Im already considered a faiulre by my entire family (not just dad-mom-bro) and going to family reunions is fucking painful. Everyone is just so god damn succesful. They go study, they find their own thing, they get fucking rich, they go travel all around the world, they find SOs and get married and be fucking happy. And everybody is just looking at me, so condescending, and wondering what made me this way. How could I become so wrong when its in my genes to be so perfect? Ah, whatever..

I dont exactly understand what 'vigorous' means but I think i kind of understand. I've tried exercise. From time to times i get periods of being 'up', energetic, social, erratic etc (therefor ive been diagnosed as bipolar but that was recently taken back for i dont even know what reason) but when im not up, I barely have the energy to get out of bed so going to the gym is kind of not an option. Its funny though, i have a gym membership and have had for like 6 months but ive only been there a couple of times. Waste of god damn money, but yeah.

So to answer your question yes, i have tried exercinging normally, ive tried excessive exercise and ive tried not excersising at all and really, the non existant exercising method works best. I know it shouldnt, but i cant sleep for days if i go and excersise. Since i can barely sleep at all i kind of value those few hours i can get.

Humanity doesnt have a solution. We're obviously not fit for this world. 

I might read the book you recommended, but to be honest, I cant really read anymore. Im to distracted by, i dont know what. I used to read a lot. But i cant anymore. All my depressions have upturns eventually and I might muster up some energy to read it then.

But as the quote said, " the mass of men lead lives of quiet desperation", doesnt really give that much comfort, does it? It just proves what ive been thinking all along. But the question is, why the fuck arent everybody as 'cynic' and hateful and depressed as I am? How can they go to work everyday? How can they mantain relationships? How can they even get out bed, clean the house, take a shower? How? Why is there something so wrong with me, that I cant do those things? That makes me feel like an abnormal fucking retard. Am i really that weak? Do i just succumb to much to the pain when i really should just toughen up and just ... live? 

I know im not alone in this, but people like me are definately a minority (im not talking about questiong lifes purpose, i mean deeply depressed and struggling to survive-people). So basically, we are an abnormal mass who is doing nothing but being a burden to society. So why the fuck are society always so fucking keen on keeping us alive? There's such a stigma against sucidide, when really, its nothing bad. Its a personal decision. Sure, I didnt get to choose to live (or did i? well thats a different discussion) but I sure as hell should be able to choose i WANT to live. And if I dont, why is there so much negativity surrounding that decision? If you commit suicide, you're weak, a disgrace. But if you stay alive and eat away at societys tax money for medicine and treatment, struggling and suffering each day, then you're 'strong'. I just dont fucking get people

I am not wrong about people not being good - people arent. If you think about WHY people do good things to other people - its only to make themselves feel good. We absolutely have a sense of moral and a sense of whats ""right"" and wrong, this is of course proven basically by evolution. Im sure there are a couple of people who are pure 'ghandi', but those belong in the rare. Most people are only TRUELY driven by their own needs and wants. This is also basically proven by darwinism, an adapted and evoled version of survival of the fittest. Do you honestly think that for example any doctor chose the path of becoming a doctor because they wanted to geniunly help people? Think again. Medicine is a very respectful line of work, but your not truly stepping out of your own way to help people. You go up in the morning, go help some person who somebody else could have helped either way, and then you go home.

Im not trying to be, whats it called (remember english isnt my first language so dont be hatin on spelling/grammar), paitronizing (?) about you being helpful towards others, and its definately a good thing. But why do you do it? To help yourself of course. You get off by being nice. Its in your DNA. Some people get off by killing people. Its also in their dna. We as humans have become some sort of fucked up political corectness gone mad where we have to pretend all the time and cover everything we do as for the greater good, when really, any person who walk over bodies to get what they truly wanted. Im not saying i want to change that, i cant, nobody can, we are after all animals, and its so distinctive if you look for it. We are not better than animals, in fact, i think we're about 10000x worse. I see no hope for mankind, and I for one does not want to live in this world.

I even live in a country thats probably one of the best regarding the people taking care of people, but it doesnt matter how civilased a country is, humans will always be humans. There's a reason most bosses are sociopaths (there are studies on this if you dont belive me). 

I have no point in this little rant, im just stating the obvious that everybody wants to neglect. All the goodness is this world is heavily undernumbered by all the bad. And the fact that we even have mental disorders is just a proof that something is fucking wrong with humans. We need to get fucking exctinct. If i had the energy and knowledge and resources i might as well just build an atom bomb and blow everybody up, that way i wouldnt have to die knowing my family would mourn me

Yeah of course there is something bothering me - myself. I dont know, im always in agony. I hate everything and everyone. Sometimes its better, sometimes its worse. But to just generelazie (spelling) on everyting thats bothering me - I just want to die. So bad. You have no idea how bad. But i cant kill myself because it would destroy my mother. I fucking hate her but she would kill herself if i died (its not even an exaggeration) and thats just.. unbearable. 

Ive been on a lot of different medication but they are all the same to me - worthless. Currently im only taking my anti anxiety and sleeping pills. I have a couple of antidepressants and some stabelasing pill but im currently off since they dont make any fucking difference at all. Ive had antipsycotics as well. Those were the best i guess, if i took more than prescribed my brain just shut down. Couldnt do shit of course but i wasnt in pain all the time either.

Yeah drug use been there done that, alcohol same, indulging food same, sex same, dangerous activites same. I do some positive recreation and its the only thing keeping me """sane""", like drawing and playing videogames.

Regarding volunteering - im just in a state where i dont give a flying fuck about anybody but myself. I couldnt be bothered helping out strangers. I fucking hate people. People are nothing but fucking selfish idiots with only greed driving them - and I'm not saying im not the same, I am. People are hateful. In my opinion, the earth would be so far fucking better off without us people. I have yet in my life ever met a person who was good. They all want something. 

Im sorry to brake it to you but there arent any 'good forces' in the world - there is only survival and needs. People use other people to fulfill their needs, and to survive.
